"""
thread_safe_lru_cache.py

A thread-safe LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with per-entry TTL
(Time-To-Live) expiry.

Features
--------
- Thread-safe via a re-entrant lock (RLock), so public methods can
  call each other safely.
- True LRU eviction: least-recently-used entries are evicted first
  when the cache exceeds its maximum size.
- Per-entry TTL: each entry may have its own time-to-live. Entries
  are checked for expiry lazily on access, and a background thread
  can proactively purge expired entries.
- Type hints throughout, generic over key and value types.
- Comprehensive docstrings and a full test suite (run the module
  directly to execute the tests).

Classes
-------
LRUCache
    The cache itself.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
import unittest
from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Callable, Generic, Iterator, Optional, Tuple, TypeVar

K = TypeVar("K")
V = TypeVar("V")

__all__ = ["LRUCache", "LRUCacheFullError"]
__author__ = "Example Author"


class LRUCacheFullError(Exception):
    """Raised when an entry cannot be stored because the cache is full
    and the existing entry cannot be evicted (e.g. ``maxsize`` <= 0)."""

    pass


class LRUCache(Generic[K, V]):
    """A thread-safe LRU cache with per-entry TTL expiry.

    The cache is generic over key and value types::

        cache: LRUCache[str, int] = LRUCache(maxsize=128, default_ttl=60.0)

    Thread safety
    -------------
    All public methods acquire an internal re-entrant lock, so the
    cache may be shared safely between threads. Iteration and bulk
    operations take a snapshot under the lock.

    Expiry model
    ------------
    Expiry is *lazy* by default: expired entries are detected and
    removed when they are read or when the cache is resized/purged.
    Optionally, a daemon janitor thread can be started with
    :meth:`start_janitor` to purge expired entries periodically.

    Parameters
    ----------
    maxsize:
        Maximum number of entries. Must be a positive integer.
    default_ttl:
        Default time-to-live in seconds for entries inserted without
        an explicit TTL.
